name: La Cantina
notes: Both photos are full printed La Cantina menu boards; photo 2 is a revised/current version of the same menu (several items renamed and re-priced, e.g. Elote 'Ribs' -> Grilled Elote, Cantina Wings -> Orange Adobo Wings, Baja Nachos -> Cantina Nachos, Street Corn Caesar -> Baja Coast Salad, Chicken Guajillo -> Chicken Adobado). Merged unique dishes from both photos; for renamed/updated items used the newer (photo 2) name, price and description. Skipped the Sides and Kids' Menu boxes (flat-price add-on groups, no per-item price) and the Zero Proof drinks list (beverages only).
